label: About
title: About Where the Fold Breaks
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 949 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Quakenbrück, by Bitchin Bajas and Bu.Re_ - Falling Into Sheer Blue, by Various Artists, plus 7 more. A source image from f4.bcbits.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Where the Fold Breaks: Chromatic segmented relief, a graphic product-photo rupture: oblique material-macro close-up suspended in black, broad focus, no setting. One oversized folded wedge chain enters cropped from lower left, tapering into teeth; a smaller detached curl holds upper right across a broad black interval. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Large diagonal magenta fold face, Broad magenta terminal on the smaller curl, and Orange-yellow inset beneath a middle fold.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
